build_config_yaml: build a minimal config.yaml for the Setup Wizard with a given LLM provider, model name, and API key
read_env_file: read a .env file and parse it into a dictionary of key-value pairs ignoring comments and blank lines
write_env_file: write key-value pairs into a .env file merging with existing entries while preserving comments and formatting
build_minimal_config: build a minimal config.yaml YAML string with model, tools, and sandbox configuration for DeerFlow
build_tools_list: build a tools list for config.yaml by filtering defaults and inserting search and web fetch tools
